function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
It really depends on a few quick factors—what you’re wearing around it, the vibe you’re going for, and even your own complexion—but here’s a handy checklist: | Factor | What to consider | |--------|------------------| | **Occasion** | • Black feels more “formal” than bright colors.
• For a night out or business meeting, a crisp black tee (or button‑down) works well.
• If it’s a relaxed weekend outing, pair it with jeans or chinos for a classic street‑style look. | | **Skin Tone & Hair Color** | • Cool undertones (blonde/ash hair, fair/light brown skin): Black often looks sharp and flattering.
• Warm undertones (brown/red hair, olive/tanned skin): You may prefer softer neutrals (navy, charcoal). Still, black can work if balanced with warm accessories. | | **Other Colors** | • Pair black with contrasting hues (white, gray, pastels) for a clean contrast.
• Layer over lighter layers (e.g., a light jacket or cardigan) so the outfit doesn’t feel too heavy. | | **Fit & Fabric** | • A slim fit shows off shape without looking tight.
• Cotton blends keep it breathable; wool or heavier fabrics lean toward dressier vibes. | ### Quick Decision Guide 1. **Need something versatile?** → Go for a basic black T‑shirt or polo. Works both day and evening. 2. **Want to stand out at a party?** → Add a pop of color with shoes or a pocket square. 3. **Heading into a professional setting?** → Pair a black button‑down with tailored trousers or a blazer. Bottom line: Yes, a black shirt usually goes great with most outfits and occasions. Just make sure the rest of your ensemble balances the formality level you’re aiming for!
